speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a pediatric patient presenting with systemic hypertension; please tell me your age and when your high blood pressure was first discovered. To begin our evaluation, have you noticed any headaches, blurred vision, or swelling in your hands or feet?

speaker: Patient
text: 5-year-old boy. The patient is presented by his mother for a well-child visit. The boy was born at 39 weeks gestation via spontaneous vaginal delivery, is currently up to date on all vaccines, and is meeting all developmental milestones. His mother reports that he has been generally doing well with no concerns. No family history of cardiovascular disease. The boy does not take any medications.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Secondary hypertension due to renal artery stenosis or renal parenchymal disease (e.g., glomerulonephritis).

REQUEST TEST: Serum creatinine, electrolytes, urinalysis, and renal ultrasound.  
REQUEST IMAGES: Renal ultrasound.
